module: Main "Race Tool" window of the race/path editor (menu Gameplay > Race/Path Editor, edit mode "Edit Races"). It manages the current race file (*.race.json, default folder /gameplay/races/): load, save, new race, copy from a scenario Time Trials, list of all races. It hosts the sub-windows (pathnodes, segments, startPositions, trackLayout, timeTrials, tools) and a "Race Test" window (testing). Loads go through the edit history (undo/redo). The current path is a gameplay/race/path object.
notes: Registered preferences (category raceEditor.general): directionalNodes (true by default), showAiRoute, showCustomFields, useSimpleDrag.
The pacenotes sub-module is commented out in the window list (not loaded). Window order: 1 pathnodes, 2 segments, 3 startPositions, 4 trackLayout, 5 timeTrials, 6 tools.
loadRace returns currentPath as of the call: since the replacement is done later by the history action (setRaceRedo), the returned value may be the old path and not the loaded one.
In setRaceRedo/setRaceUndo, the loop "for _, window in ipairs(windows)" calls currentWindow and not window: only the current window is updated, N times.
An "All Races" dialog searches all *.race.json files across the whole virtual file system (may take a few seconds).

allowGizmo.desc: Returns whether the edit gizmo is allowed: true when the current edit mode is "Edit Races".

returns.desc: true if the current edit mode is the race editor's.

calculateAiRoute.desc: Calls autoConfig() then getAiPath() on the current path to recompute the AI route (and the aiPathDistance distance).

changedFromExternal.desc: Call when the current path was modified outside the window: gives the path back to the active sub-window (setPath).

getCurrentFilename.desc: Returns the full path of the current race file (folder + name).

getCurrentPath.desc: Returns the gameplay/race/path object being edited.

isVisible.desc: Returns whether the "Race Tool" window is displayed.

loadRace.desc: Reads a .race.json file, builds a new path (onDeserialized), recomputes the AI route and commits a "Set path to <name>" history action to replace it. Does nothing if filename is nil; logs an error if the file is not found.

returns.desc: currentPath (see notes: may be the old path).

onDeserialized.desc: Called after a Lua reload with the saved state; restores the path, the file name and folder, then recomputes the AI route.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame. Draws the Race Tool window (File menu, lists, sub-window tabs) and switches back to objectSelect mode if the window is hidden.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Declares the raceEditMode edit mode, registers the window (500x500) and the menu entry, then instantiates the sub-windows and the test window.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Declares the raceEditor preferences category (directionalNodes, showAiRoute, showCustomFields, useSimpleDrag).

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: If the hidden window is raceEditorTool, switches back to objectSelect mode.

onSerialize.desc: Called before a Lua reload; serializes the current path and the last folder/file name.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook; draws the "Race Test" window (testingWindow:draw(dtSim)) when it is open.

dtSim.desc: Simulation time delta passed to the test window.

onWindowGotFocus.desc: If the window gaining focus is raceEditorTool, activates the raceEditMode edit mode.

saveRace.desc: Serializes a race and writes it as JSON (jsonWriteFile, pretty format). Updates the remembered folder and file name.

race.desc: Race path to save; if nil, uses the current path.

savePath.desc: Full path of the output file.

setupRace.desc: Opens the "Race Test" window, gives it the current path and prepares the test race (testingWindow:setupRace).

show.desc: Clears the selection, shows the Race Tool window and activates the raceEditMode edit mode.
